description: Questions about the house, answered without changing anything: who's home, is Cameron/Paget home, is the door/window open, is anything still on, how's the air in the house, do the plants need water. Added 2026-11-09.

command: how's the air in the house
how is the air in the house
(what's|what is) the air quality in the house
do I need to water the plants

sequence.set_conversation_response: {% set h = ['person.cameron','person.paget'] | select('is_state','home') | map('state_attr','friendly_name') | list %}{% if h | count == 2 %}Cameron and Paget are both home.{% elif h %}{{ h[0] }} is home.{% else %}Nobody's home.{% endif %}{{ ' Guest mode is on.' if is_state('input_boolean.guest_mode','on') else '' }}

{% set p = 'paget' if 'paget' in s else 'cameron' %}{% set n = p | capitalize %}{% set st = states('person.' ~ p) %}{% if st == 'home' %}{{ n }} is home.{% elif st == 'not_home' %}{{ n }} is out.{% elif st in ['unknown','unavailable'] %}I don't know where {{ n }} is.{% else %}{{ n }} is at {{ st }}.{% endif %}

{% if 'window' in s %}{% set e = 'binary_sensor.window_sensor' %}{% set w = 'window' %}{% else %}{% set e = 'binary_sensor.door_sensor' %}{% set w = 'door' %}{% endif %}{% set st = states(e) %}{% if st == 'on' %}The {{ w }} is open{% set since = (now() - states[e].last_changed).total_seconds() // 60 %}{{ ', and has been for ' ~ (since | int) ~ ' minutes' if 1 < since < 180 else '' }}.{% elif st == 'off' %}The {{ w }} is closed.{% else %}I can't tell, the {{ w }} sensor isn't responding.{% endif %}

{% set lights = states.light | rejectattr('entity_id','in',['light.all_lights','light.kitchen_lights','light.master_bedroom_lights','light.living_room']) | selectattr('state','eq','on') | map(attribute='name') | list %}{% set things = [] %}{% if lights %}{% set things = things + [lights | join(', ') ] %}{% endif %}{% if not is_state('climate.living_room','off') %}{% set things = things + ['the heat pump'] %}{% endif %}{% if is_state('switch.smart_plug','on') %}{% set things = things + ['the smart plug'] %}{% endif %}{% if is_state('switch.tp_link_power_strip_6e3f_dehumidifier','on') %}{% set things = things + ['the dehumidifier'] %}{% endif %}{% set playing = ['media_player.bedroom_echo','media_player.homepod_mini_kitchen_2','media_player.living_room_amp_2','media_player.guest_bedroom_homepod_mini_2'] | select('is_state','playing') | map('state_attr','friendly_name') | list %}{% if playing %}{% set things = things + ['music on ' ~ playing | join(' and ')] %}{% endif %}{% if things %}On right now: {{ things | join('; ') }}.{% else %}Everything's off.{% endif %}

{% set k = states('sensor.air_quality_monitor_temperature') | float(none) %}{% set b = states('sensor.air_quality_monitor_temperature_2') | float(none) %}{% set kh = states('sensor.air_quality_monitor_humidity') | float(none) %}{% set bh = states('sensor.air_quality_monitor_humidity_2') | float(none) %}{% set pm = [states('sensor.air_quality_monitor_pm2_5') | float(0), states('sensor.air_quality_monitor_pm2_5_2') | float(0)] | max %}{% set voc = [states('sensor.air_quality_monitor_voc_index') | float(0), states('sensor.air_quality_monitor_voc_index_2') | float(0)] | max %}The air is {{ 'poor' if pm > 35 or voc > 250 else 'okay' if pm > 12 or voc > 150 else 'good' }}. {% if k is not none %}The kitchen is {{ k | round(0) | int }} degrees{{ ' and ' ~ (kh | round(0) | int) ~ ' percent humidity' if kh is not none else '' }}. {% endif %}{% if b is not none %}The bedroom is {{ b | round(0) | int }} degrees{{ ' and ' ~ (bh | round(0) | int) ~ ' percent humidity' if bh is not none else '' }}.{% endif %}

{% set f = states('sensor.soil_moisture_sensor_1_humidity') | float(none) %}{% set b = states('sensor.moisture_sensor_2_humidity') | float(none) %}{{ 'Yes, something needs water.' if is_state('binary_sensor.any_plant_needs_water','on') else 'No, they are fine.' }}{% if f is not none %} The fiddle leaf fig is at {{ f | round(0) | int }} percent{% endif %}{% if b is not none %}{{ ' and the' if f is not none else ' The' }} banana leaf is at {{ b | round(0) | int }} percent{% endif %}{{ ' moisture.' if f is not none or b is not none else '' }}
